title: Gym
description: Plan, train, and track your progress.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.sourceUnit: Source weight unit for unitless imports
inputs.sourceTimezone: Source timezone for timestamps without an offset
inputs.replaceConfirmation: Type REPLACE GYM to replace all Gym data
inputs.resetConfirmation: Type RESET GYM to clear all Gym data

description.inherit: Each workout derives targets from the routine rule and completed history.
description.linear: Meet every set target to add load; repeated misses trigger a deload.
description.greyskull: Final-set extra reps can earn a larger increase; a miss reduces load.
description.double: Build repetitions within your range, then add load and restart at the lower target.
description.time: Complete the prescribed hold in every set to increase duration.

suggestions.baseline: No completed history yet — establish your baseline.
suggestions.success: Previous targets met. Use the suggested next target.
suggestions.bodyweight-success: Bodyweight targets met — aim for {{reps}} repetitions.
suggestions.bodyweight-hold: Keep the bodyweight target until every set is complete.
suggestions.amrap-double: The final set doubled its repetition target and earned a larger increase.
suggestions.miss: Last session missed its targets — repeat them before increasing.
suggestions.stalled: {{misses}} missed sessions — reduce the target and rebuild.
suggestions.rep-range: Keep the load and aim for {{reps}} repetitions.

messages.staleDraft: This item changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; reload the saved version before editing again.
messages.noExercises: Add your first exercise to this routine.
messages.noRoutines: Create a routine or load the starter plan.
messages.archiveExercise: Archive this custom exercise? Saved workouts retain their original details.
messages.archiveRoutine: Archive this routine? Workout history is retained.
messages.finishEarly: Finish with {{done}} of {{total}} sets complete? Only completed sets count toward progress.
messages.discardWorkout: Discard this active workout? Its sets will not count toward your progress.
messages.removeExercise: Remove this exercise and its logged sets from the active workout?

library.catalogInfo: {{count}} catalog exercises, with text instructions. Custom exercises use your own notes.

plan.overrideHelp: A date-specific plan replaces the weekly assignment, including an explicit rest day.
plan.supersetHelp: Link adjacent exercises to perform them back to back. Rest starts after the final partner.

workout.startHelp: The active workout is saved to your account. Return here to resume it.
workout.supersetHelp: Superset: perform these exercises back to back, then rest after the final partner.
workout.timerHelp: Stopping early logs the time actually held. Timers resume from their saved start time.
workout.emptyFreestyle: Add an exercise to begin your freestyle workout.

wake.unsupported: This browser does not support screen wake lock.
wake.unavailable: Screen wake lock could not be kept; check your device power settings.

workout.offline: You are offline. A loaded workout can keep a local draft; start, timed-set commands and finishing require a connection.
workout.offlineDraft: Your changes are saved on this browser and are waiting for a connection.
workout.recoveryHelp: Reconnect to match this draft with the current session. If the session changed or ended elsewhere, the recovery stays here until you choose to remove it.
workout.clearRecoveryConfirm: Remove this browser’s active workout recovery? Unsent changes will be lost.
workout.storageUnavailable: This browser could not save active workout recovery. Keep this tab open until your changes are sent.
workout.syncConflict: The saved workout changed elsewhere. Your draft and original pending command are retained. Reload the saved version, or explicitly apply your draft after reviewing it.
workout.syncFailed: Changes were not acknowledged. Your local draft is preserved. Retry sends the same pending command safely.
workout.rebaseConfirm: Apply your retained draft over the latest saved version? This replaces that session’s current sets and details.
workout.synced: All changes are saved to your account.
workout.confirmWorkingWeight: Use {{weight}} {{unit}} for all remaining sets? Completed sets and your original target stay unchanged.
workout.leaveHelp: Your unsent active workout draft will stay on this browser if you leave. Return and reconnect to send it.

dashboard.activeHelp: You have an active workout. Resume or discard it before starting another.

settings.hostAppearance: Gym follows your Monolith theme, language and account settings.
settings.effortHelp: Effort is optional. Existing RIR and RPE ratings keep their original scale when this setting changes.
settings.soundUnavailable: Sound is unavailable in this browser.
settings.reminderHelp: Save these preferences. With permission already granted, planned-day reminders appear while Gym is open and visible, once per day and reminder time in the chosen timezone. Configure background delivery below.
settings.notificationsUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.

notificationPermission.denied: Browser notifications are blocked in browser settings.

settings.notificationTest: Your workout notification test is working.
settings.backupHelp: A full backup contains your training data and settings. Plan files exclude history, weigh-ins and settings.
settings.resetWarning: This removes your routines, schedule, workouts, custom exercises, weigh-ins and Gym preferences. Export a backup first. Your Monolith account is retained.
settings.resetConfirm: Permanently clear all your Gym training data?
settings.pushHelp: Receive planned workout, rest timer and coach reminders while this workspace is closed. Browser and operating system delivery rules apply.
settings.pushUnavailable: Background push is unavailable until the server has VAPID keys configured.
settings.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support background push.
settings.pushInsecure: Background push requires HTTPS or localhost.
settings.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in browser settings, then retry.
settings.pushDefault: Notification permission has not been granted.
settings.pushQueued: {{count}} test notification(s) queued. Delivery is confirmed only when received.
settings.pushDisabled: Background notifications disabled for this browser.
settings.pushBrowserError: Browser notification status could not be read: {{error}}

pushSetup.unsupported: This browser does not support background push.
pushSetup.insecure: Use HTTPS or localhost for background notifications.
pushSetup.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in browser settings, then retry.
pushSetup.dismissed: Permission was not granted. Use Enable to try again.
pushSetup.keyUnavailable: The server push key is missing or invalid.
pushSetup.keyChanged: The server push key changed. Disable this browser, then enable it again.
pushSetup.workerUnavailable: The Gym notification worker could not activate. Reload and retry.
pushSetup.subscriptionInvalid: The browser returned an invalid push subscription.
pushSetup.unsubscribeFailed: The server registration was removed, but browser removal failed. Retry Disable.

settings.pushUnmatched: This browser subscription is not registered to this account. Disable it before enabling notifications for this account.

import.title: Import training data
import.help: Review JSON backups or shared plans, workout CSV files, and Apple Health XML before importing.
import.confirm: Import the reviewed data into your account?
import.counts: {{workouts}} workouts · {{routines}} routines · {{sets}} sets · {{bodyweight}} weigh-ins · {{duplicates}} duplicates skipped · {{skipped_rows}} rows skipped
import.unmatched: New custom exercises for unmatched names:
import.includeSchedule: Replace the weekly schedule with the imported schedule
import.replaceWarning: Replacement removes current training data before restoring this file. Export a backup first. Imported settings and schedules are applied only if selected.

history.invalidRange: The start date must precede the end date.
history.activeNotice: This session is still in progress. Resume it to edit your sets.
history.confirmDelete: Delete this workout? Its sets will be removed from progress statistics.
history.recalculate: Saving recalculates records, trends and future progression from the corrected sets.
history.calendarHelp: Select a day to view completed workouts and its planned routine. Date-specific plans override the weekly schedule.
history.calendarEmptyDay: No completed workouts or planned routine on this day.

stats.weightUpsert: One weigh-in per day. Saving a date again updates that entry.
stats.activity: Workout activity over the last 13 weeks
stats.activityLegend: Each square is one day, from oldest to newest. Brighter squares indicate more workouts.
stats.muscleExplanation: Completed sets contribute to the primary muscle; secondary muscles receive half credit. Hard sets have a logged effort of 3 RIR or less.
stats.effortSummary: {{count}} rated sets · average {{average}} RIR · {{hard}} hard sets
stats.noTrend: Log this exercise to see its progress.
stats.estimateCaution: Estimates use completed sets of 1–12 reps. They are a training reference, not a recommendation to attempt that load.
stats.rangeHelp: This range applies to workout totals, muscle coverage, effort and exercise progress. Consistency shows the current week and last 13 weeks.
stats.noPeriodWorkouts: No completed workouts in this period.
stats.hardShare: {{value}}% of rated sets at 3 RIR / 7 RPE or harder
stats.effortMinimum: Headline averages require at least 5 rated sets. Weekly points require at least 2.
stats.effortDisabled: Effort logging is off; existing ratings are still included.
stats.distance_km: Distance from logged speed and time
stats.exerciseModeHelp: Showing completed {{mode}} sets. Sessions logged in another mode are excluded.
stats.noMetricData: No completed sets with this metric in this period.
stats.analyticsDescription: Your training, measured from completed workouts and recorded weigh-ins.
stats.completedOnly: Completed sets across all logging modes
stats.sessionTime: Total elapsed time of completed sessions
stats.noRatings: No effort ratings in this period.

coach.description: Create or refine a training plan using your Monolith agents. Choose which proposed changes to apply; your workout history remains intact.
coach.workerRequirement: A connected CLI, Codex, OpenClaw or external worker executes coaching jobs. Requests and token consumption appear in Agents. Scheduled reviews run when that worker polls its inbox.
coach.consent: Allow this agent to receive my training data for coaching
coach.consentDetails: The selected worker receives this intake, your plan, up to 30 recent workouts and weigh-ins, and relevant exercise names. Enabling coaching grants contributor access to its dedicated Projects workspace. Disabling coaching or withdrawing consent cancels active Gym jobs.
coach.limitations: Limitations and restrictions you want to share
coach.feedback: Feedback or instructions for this proposal
coach.confirmRevert: Restore the plan from before the last coaching application?
coach.revertExplanation: Revert restores routines and the schedule only. It is disabled if you have changed the plan since applying the proposal.
coach.archiveExplanation: This routine will be archived and removed from your schedule. Its historical workouts remain available.
coach.stale: Your plan changed after this proposal. Request a new review before applying it.

offline.settingsHelp: Opt in to keep plans, exercises, history and an existing workout draft on this device. Anyone using this browser can read the cache. Signing out removes it. Reconnect to start, save or finish a workout.
offline.title: Device cache
offline.help: This is a cached view. Plans and history are read-only; existing workout edits remain a local draft. Reconnect and review conflicts before saving or finishing.
offline.savedDraft: Workout draft saved on this device.
offline.storageError: Device caching is unavailable or full. Your server data is unchanged.
offline.clearConfirm: Remove this device’s cached Gym profile? Existing workout recovery is retained for the next authenticated login.
offline.missing: No opted-in Gym cache is available. Connect and enable device caching in Gym settings.
offline.noActive: No active workout was cached. Reconnect to start one.
offline.draftConflict: Another tab changed the retained workout. Reconnect and review the latest draft; this offline copy has not overwritten it.
